nom: MEDIHEAL Rose PDRN Derma Cream Pack Cleanser

avis.titre: Happy 😄 FaceHappy 😄 Face
avis.texte: Thank you for the fast delivery! It came in good condition and I absolutely love this cleanser and face mask. It leaves my face feeling very clean, smooth, and refreshed. I also have sensitive, acne-prone skin, and it did not break me out at all. Very happy with how my skin looks and feels!

avis.titre: Amazing squeaky clean cleanser + Kpop idol usesAmazing squeaky clean cleanser + Kpop idol uses
avis.texte: I bought this cleanser as it was recommended by Jeon Somi, who only promotes products she really loves and uses, in her gym essentials. She uses it after a sweaty workout, and I can totally see why! It is perfect for calming skin and getting a deep, non irritating cleanse. I have very sensitive, hormonal acne prone skin. I love mediheal masks and if those work for you, this will be even better. The texture and color of the mask looks just like the product images and feels like a sea spa. There is no scent to me besides nature. It truly clarifies my skin. I have a balancing cleanser and exfoliating cleanser that I alternate between. This feels like a combination of both. It could be slightly drying if no products are applied right after, but the deep gentle cleanse is fast and wonderful! My skin feels refreshed and bouncy after. I highly recommend.

avis.titre: Good gentle cleanserGood gentle cleanser
avis.texte: This is a very thick, moisturizing cleanser that is versatile: you can either use as is, or lather it up into a foamier cleanser. Very easy to incorporate into a daily routine. I have been using it for several weeks now. I can't say it's so effective that my skin feels dramatically improved, but it also hasn't caused any irritation or breakouts. It feels very gentle. My least favorite part is the smell -- it's just kind of a bland soapy smell. Overall, seems like a decent value for a gentle cleanser.

avis.titre: Great Product for Dry (old) Skin
avis.texte: Wonderful facial mask-to-cleanser. Does not dry out skin and smells like fresh cut roses. Will continue to buy.

avis.titre: Good cleanser, great mask
avis.texte: I've been really enjoying this Mediheal Derma Cream Pack Cleanser! As a daily cleanser, it's pretty good—it leaves my skin feeling clean without feeling stripped or overly dry, and I appreciate how gentle it is on my sensitive skin. That said, I actually prefer using it as a mask, and that's where I think it truly shines. I apply a generous layer, leave it on for about a minute, and then rinse it off. Afterward, my pores look noticeably cleaner, and my skin feels incredibly fresh, smooth, and refreshed. It gives me that deep-clean feeling without any irritation or tightness. I also love the creamy texture and the little Centella leaf particles. The formula feels nourishing while still doing a great job removing buildup and excess oil. Unlike some pore-clearing products, this one doesn't leave my face feeling dry or uncomfortable afterward. Overall, this is a versatile product that works well as both a cleanser and a mask, but for me, it's become a go-to quick mask treatment when I want my skin to feel extra clean and nice. I'll definitely be repurchasing!

avis.titre: ねっとりしたパックが洗顔にも使える！ざらつきが無くなり、しっとりとした肌になりました。
avis.texte: 思ったよりも、ねっとりとした粘度です。 パックした後に少し洗顔しながら洗い流すと泡立つので洗顔も行えます、 しっとりとして毛穴が引き締まったような肌質になります。 そういえば、これを使い始めてから、顎周りのニキビができなくなったような気がします。 匂いはなんと表現したら良いか、文字であらわすのが難しいですが、柔らかな優しいロゼ系の匂いです。 香りは強くないと思います。 顔に塗るのに「あ、良い匂い」と思う程度なので、匂いに敏感な方も使えるかな？ 私はリラックスする匂いなので好きです。 これを使用する時間が大切なリラックスの時間にもなっていると感じます。 ニキビができなくなったのも嬉しい変化ですが、パックをしている時間のリラックス効果もとても重要な要素だと思っています。 また購入したいです。というか続けます！

avis.titre: Two for the price of one
avis.texte: Fantastic product. Can be used as a cleanser or a lush mask. Leaves my skin dewy and fresh. Smells wonderful.

avis.titre: Fresh Faced
avis.texte: Loving this mask to cleanser PDRN. A little goes a long way leaves my skin feeling dewy, cleansed and refreshed. Also smells like fresh roses.

avis.titre: 面白い使用感です。面白い使用感です。
avis.texte: 乾いた顔に直接塗布するパック兼洗顔料です。 かなりねとっとしていて、ガムのような重く糸を引いて粘着するようなテクスチャです。 あっているのかな？というくらい塗りにくい粘度ですが、その分ぴったりと顔全体に密着してくれます。 髪の毛をおろしているとべたべたとまとわりつくのでまとめた状態での使用がおすすめです。手についたものも洗い流すのに時間がかかるので入浴直前に塗ってから使用しています。 鼻や口にかかるように雑に塗っていると、膜が張って危うく息ができないようなこともあったので少し注意が必要です。 しばらく待っていると塗布した部分がピリピリとしてきますので、そのタイミングで洗い流しています。使用後はツヤっとした肌になり、個人的には満足のいく洗い心地でした。

avis.titre: ネバネバが強くて使いにくいネバネバが強くて使いにくい
avis.texte: 洗顔○ パック△ 使い勝手× 香り◎ 粘度が高すぎて使い勝手が良くない。 パックと洗顔とどちらも使えるとのことですが、乾いた肌にこんなに粘度の高いものを塗っても何も肌には入ってこないし、ただねっちょりした液体が乗ってるだけに感じました。 洗い流すのも大変です、ずっと泡が出てきます；； 糸を引くほどに粘度が高く、洗顔として使うにしてもこんなに粘度が高いと泡立てる前に手のひらにこべりつく。 洗顔ネットを使えば良いですが、結構ワシワシしないとネットに液が残ります。 スクラブっぽく見えるのは薔薇の花びら？のようです。 ゴリゴリするタイプではなく、優しい洗い心地です。 香りもとても薔薇の良い香りがします。 洗い上がりはしっとりで、肌がキメ細やかに整った気がします。 でも使い勝手が悪いので出番が少ないです。。

avis.titre: Smells amazing and feels luxurious
avis.texte: I love how my skin feels after using Mediheal rose PDRN cream cleanser! I get the kbeauty glow.

avis.titre: Wonderful when used as cleanser, skin feels soft after use
avis.texte: Amazing product that can be used as a mask or cleanser. I've only used it as a cleanser but the texture is thick enough that it would work well as a mask. There is a natural herbal/medicinal scent and contains some particles that I think are supposed to exfoliate the skin. I am in my late 30s so I am prone to dry skin and also some hormonal acne/rosacea so I'm hoping this cleanser/mask will help with this. It's been good so far! I use it as a second step of double cleansing, I use an oil cleanser first. Then, I take a small amount of this cleanser and use it to wash my face. I do massage my skin for a few seconds first and let the helpful ingredients soak in a bit then wash it off. It washes off nicely with no residue and my skin doesn't feel too dry after use. It feels soft and comfortable with no irritation. I was afraid the little particles would bother me but there are so few that I didn't even notice them while washing my face. It does seem to effectively remove the residual makeup on my face that the oil cleanser may have missed. I'd say it is very easy to use because it's only a 1 minute mask and you can do it quickly in the morning or at nighttime. I really like this cleanser/mask because of the versatility, and the ingredients. I would say that it is very much worth the money and would recommend it to those with similar skin to mine (dry but also acne prone).

avis.titre: A tiny squeeze, a mountain of foam
avis.texte: Likes: • Rich foaming action • Removes makeup and facial oils easily • A little goes a long way, making it a solid value • Happy to find a Mediheal product easily available in the States Dislikes: • Cleansing power can leave skin feeling a bit dry I picked up the Mediheal Derma Cream Pack Cleanser [Madecassoside] after having a great experience with the brand during a trip to South Korea, and this cleanser reminded me exactly why Mediheal has such a loyal following. The texture starts off creamy, but the moment water hits it, it explodes into a rich foam that feels like it multiplies on contact. I only needed a pea‑sized amount to get a full face of makeup and sunscreen completely cleaned off, which makes the tube feel like it’ll last forever. Performance‑wise, it does its job extremely well. It breaks down oils, foundation, and the general end‑of‑day grime without needing a second pass. The tradeoff is that it can leave my skin feeling a little tight afterward, so following up with a moisturizer is a must. That said, the formula includes madecassoside, which is known for being soothing, and I didn’t experience any irritation even with daily use.

avis.titre: Not as hydrating as I expected, but nice as a face wash for normal to oily skin
avis.texte: I had to look up what a “pack” was, and the internet tells me it’s interchangeable with a mask. I thought this would be a great way to both hydrate my dry skin while washing my face in one-step. While it works fine as a wash, it left my face dryer than I’d hoped. Still, it will be great for my roommate who has oily skin. It’s a gooey cream that takes just a pea-sized amount to spread all over my face. It tingles when left on for a minute which I’m not sure is a good thing. It has a slightly herbal smell, and wasn’t hard to apply, although it never seems to dry to the point of stretching like rubber and peeling off like they show on the box. It’s a bit more than I spend on just a face wash. Expires 11/10/2028.

avis.titre: Unique Mask To Foam Discovery
avis.texte: This mask to foam hybrid is such a cool discovery. It's my first time trying a face cleanser from Mediheal, though I've used one of their serums before and really liked it. I apply this to my dry face like a mask and let it sit for about a minute. This allows the formula, which includes Madecassoside & Niacinamide to really sink in. After that, I add a little water and begin massaging it in just like a face wash. It feels luxurious and creamy. I prefer removing it with the textured side of a disposable face cloth because it provides that extra level of deep cleansing. Using the textured side offers a bit of exfoliation, so it feels like I'm really getting the product into my pores more thoroughly before the final rinse. It's almost like a mini facial every time I wash my face because the cloth pairs so well with the Centella leaves in the cream to help with congestion. It has a refreshing, minty like scent from the rosemary and botanical oils that makes the whole experience feel like a luxury treatment. While it sits on my skin, I can feel it tingling as it works on cleaning out pores. It's great to find something that feels this active while still being a non-irritating formula. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and looking supple. This is a fun, effective way to handle daily buildup and pore care in one quick step. I'm basically getting the benefits of 2 treatments in 1 which makes it a great value.

avis.titre: A creamy cleanser that massages easily into foam
avis.texte: Pink cream comes out thick with visible crushed rose petal flecks suspended through it. The color sits between translucent and milky, with small darker pieces that look like actual plant fragments. It has a light floral scent that leans softly toward rose without being perfumey. The texture is creamy and cushiony, spreads easily, and glides across the skin without drag. The petal flecks are soft and sparse, so they do not feel scratchy. They mostly dissolve or move around while you massage the cleanser in. This formula can be used two ways. As a one-minute pack, it sits on the skin like a creamy mask before rinsing. I ended up massaging it in instead because the texture makes that step enjoyable. It turns slightly foamy even before water is added and rinses clean without leaving that oily residue some cream cleansers have. It leaves the sking very soft and feeling balanced, not dried out. The packaging uses a soft squeeze tube with a flip cap that closes securely. The opening dispenses a thick ribbon of product, so it is easy to control the amount. For around $20 for 120 mL, this is high value and in the range of a daily cleanser rather than a specialty treatment. The texture, light scent, and visible petal pieces make it a pleasant one to reach for.

avis.titre: Gentle Cleanser That Leaves Skin Soft – Just a Very Grassy Scent
avis.texte: I’ve really been enjoying the Mediheal Derma Cream Pack Cleanser with Madecassoside. The concept of a 1-minute mask that transforms into a foam cleanser is actually very convenient. I apply it like a quick mask first, then add a little water and it lathers into a soft foam that cleans my skin really well without stripping it. The texture is smooth and creamy, and it leaves my face feeling hydrated, calm, and very clean. My pores feel refreshed afterward, and my skin feels soft rather than tight or dry. It also seems very gentle, so it’s great for daily use and doesn’t irritate my skin at all. The only thing worth noting is the scent. It has a very grassy, herbal smell, which may come from the ingredients. It’s not necessarily bad, just quite earthy and noticeable when you first apply it. Overall, if you’re looking for a gentle cleanser that doubles as a quick mask and leaves skin feeling smooth and refreshed, this is a great option.

avis.titre: Unique Mask-to-Foam Cleanser That Brightens Skin
avis.texte: This Mediheal Derma Cream Pack Cleanser has a really interesting texture that makes it stand out from a typical face wash. It starts as a creamy mask that you leave on briefly and then turns into a light foam once you add water. I enjoy the dual use because it feels like a quick treatment and cleanser in one step. The formula feels sturdy and well made, not watery or thin, and a small amount spreads easily across the face. The scent is mild and clean, which I appreciate since heavily fragranced skincare can be overwhelming. I had no skin irritation at all, even with regular use, and my skin felt comfortable and hydrated afterward. Over time I noticed my skin looked a little brighter and smoother, which was a nice bonus. For the quality and how little you need per use, I think it offers pretty good value for the money, earning it a solid four stars from me.

avis.titre: Mediheal Derma Cream Pack Cleanser  -  I enjoy it as a mask and a facial cleanser.
avis.texte: I have been using Mediheal Derma Cream Pack Cleanser for the last week or so in the morning. I like this product. What I've been doing is spreading some of the product on my nose and T-zone area. I leave that on my face while I make the bed and get my clothes out for the day. The product dries up that area a bit. It does make my T-zone less oily for the day. Then, as I get into the shower, I use a little more of the product and give my face a good, creamy scrubbing. The cleanser lathers and rinses away easily. It has a light herbal scent and a gentle tingling sensation upon application. Most importantly, it leaves my skin feeling smooth and comfortable without any irritation. I still apply moisturizer before my makeup in the morning, but I am thoroughly enjoying this product's versatility as both a mask and a cleanser."

avis.titre: AMAZING!! 🩷🩷
avis.texte: I love Mediheal products. I already own many of their skincare items and know I can trust the brand. I didn't have this one, nor had I ever heard of the Madecassoside Derma Cream Pack Cleanser before seeing it on Amazon. There are two ways to use this product: as a cleanser or as a cleansing mask. I've been dealing with skin issues like hormonal acne and dermatitis from my inhaler, and Madecassoside has been a lifesaver since I hit menopause. This mask has a light, clean scent, feels very silky when applied, and only needs to be left on for one minute. A little goes a long way, so you don't need much. Since I've recently developed sensitive skin, I was cautious about trying new skincare products, but this did not irritate my skin or worsen my acne. It has actually helped clear up my complexion. My skin was so soft and less irritated after rinsing off the cleanser. It's affordable and worth the money. So, if you're struggling with acne, rosacea, or dermatitis, I highly recommend this product for you!

avis.titre: Lovely smell and a nice glow
avis.texte: I wanted to try this out because I have been having great luck with Korean skincare products and I loved that this one has real rose petals and collagen. This has a very thick texture like something between a paste and a silky gel. The texture was not so easy to lather up but I think that's because I used a bit too much. If I use even less than I did this time, the bottle, which is bigger than I expected, should last me a good long time making it a great value. The smell is fantastic and actually smells like real roses which I could see the pieces of in the product. I could not feel the pieces of rose when I use it though and they did not cause any irritation or harsh rubbing. After using this my face felt clean, plumped and well hydrated with a nice glowy finish. I will happily continue to use this up and would definitely get it again in a heartbeat. Definitely recommend to anyone who also likes to use a good Korean skincare product and loves a good quality floral scent.

avis.titre: ZERO IRRITATION, LEAVES SKIN BARRIER INTACT
avis.texte: So this is Korean skincare? This gentle rose-petal-infused skin cleanser can be used as an immediate skin-to-foam- to-rinse cleanser or a one-minute leave-on before rinsing for more moisture. The scent is light and fresh. The texture is really creamy, almost like a buttercream frosting, but also sticky and goopy. A little goes a long way. If I decide to use it as a 1-minute mask, I apply to dry skin as directed. I leave on for minute. Absolutely zero irritation. I then add a little bit of water to create the foamy lather and rinse off with warm water. It rinses off a 100% clean, leaving no residue behind. What I love about this cleanser is that not only does it work, but it doesn't strip my skin of my own oils. It leaves my skin barrier intact. That's the magic of this cleanser! I can see from the listing that there is a 0.00 irritation score, so it's great for sensitive skin like mine. (I do have rosacea.) This is hands down one of the best cleansers I've ever used. To note, I have extremely dry skin and often use oil-based cleansers to protect my skin barrier. Great value for the money. This tube should last at least three months because of the large quantity at 4 ounces.

avis.titre: Great ingredients for gentle cleansing, hydration, soothing & barrier support. Soothing/hydrating.
avis.texte: This cream cleanser, which can also be used as a one minute mask, contains an impressive collection of ingredients for gentle cleansing, hydration, soothing, and barrier support. I applied this according to the instructions for one minute as a quick mask and then cleansed my face. The product feels great on the skin and produces a substantial amount of lather. After use, my skin felt gently cleansed but also very hydrated. This is not a product that will leave your skin with a squeaky clean/dry feeling but rather one that feels like it is actively improving the skin. I have rosacea and very easily irritated skin. Though this product contains a few botanical extracts that have the potential to irritate extremely sensitive skin, my skin was not at all irritated by the cleanser. I have tried several Mediheal products, and have really liked them all. This product is no exception. As the tube is large and will last quite a while, I consider this to be a good value at $21. I look forward to continuing to incorporate this into my skincare routine and to trying more products from this Korean brand.

avis.titre: Absolutely loveee this cleanser!
avis.texte: Ok. Stop what you're doing and grab this product!!! I have loved this brand for a while as I am completely addicted to their eye patches. So when I saw they had a PDRN face wash...I was obsessed. The package comes sealed in foil nefore using for the first time. The consistency of the cleanser is thick and the Rose scent is DIVINE. I swear I washed my face and both my kids told me I smelled good when they came close to me. When you first use the cleanser, you can see tiny red rose particles in it. Almost like micro-sturdy/gritty pieces. They felt wonderful when you rubbed them into your skin (mixed with water) into a paste-like consistency. (I showed it on my hand as an example.) Furthermore it left my skin looking bright, feeling refreshed and smelling amazing. It was truly invigorating. I highly recommend this product and is a great value for the money as you only alneed a little mixed with water to make a great lather.

avis.titre: Fragrantly Floral
avis.texte: Packed in a flip cap tube. Beneath the cap reveals a tamper foil seal. Easy to open and to dispense by squeeze. Texture similar to toothpaste then foams when agitated. Soft and pliable. Simple to spread evenly. Soft violet in color. Lightly floral in fragrance. Smell decreases after rinsing. Gentle while effectively cleans. Non-drying! Non-abrasive. With fair-skin, can't attest if it increased brightening. Great for those with sensitive skin. Feels refreshing without a heavy film left behind. Worth the value and the time in giving this a try.

avis.titre: Innovative cleanser/mask leaves my skin clean and soft
avis.texte: Mediheal's Derma Cream Pack Cleanser is an innovative product that can be used either as a cleanser or, for deeper cleansing, as a one-minute mask. With either use, it does take a while to rinse the product off. The texture is thick and substantial but not unpleasant. The product is easy to use, and does a wonderful job cleansing the skin and leaving it soft and clear.
